user.title: House sensors and systems
user.description: Choose all member temperature sensors and controlled HVAC systems. Removing an entity here removes it from control.

tunables.title: Control settings
tunables.description: Temperatures are in °C. PI integral gain is per control interval. Optional context sources are recorded for future learning.
